verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents several pieces of the money flow: amount splits configured on payins, merchant deposits with configurable frequency, per-merchant billing profiles that set fees, an embeddable reporting component, and full data export. Together these imply traceability from charge through split to payout. However, no evidence shows a ledger that exposes balances by seller or by platform fee account, or any penny-level reconciliation tooling. Missing for 10: per-seller and platform fee-account balance views, documented charge-to-split-to-payout linkage on deposit records, reconciliation reports or settlement files, independent corroboration.
